events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon released an album that would become a timeless anthem for peace. Still as relevant as ever.

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, better known as Sting, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: From The Police frontman to a stellar solo career, Sting turns 75 today! What's your favourite track from the legendary musician?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remembering The iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. Do you remember your first one?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! What's your top 007 film, gadget, or theme song? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon, born in Liverpool, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic legend and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album.' A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul' – an album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, the world still remembers John Lennon. His music and message of peace resonate as strongly as ever.

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Starman
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the enduring genius of David Bowie. A true chameleon of rock.

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music still moves millions around the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod The Mod
angles.copy: From the Faces to solo stardom, Sir Rod Stewart turns 82 today! Raise a glass to a true music legend.

events.title: Suggs Turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... It's Suggs' 66th birthday! Wishing a brilliant day to the Madness frontman.
